info.title: Bulk Domain Security, SSL/TLS, Headers & DMARC Auditor (Apify Cloud API)
info.description:
High-speed multi-domain infrastructure scanner benchmarking TLS 1.3, SSL certificate expiry, HSTS, CSP, and SPF/DKIM/DMARC email security compliance in seconds.

RapidAPI Cloud Integration powered by Apify Pay-Per-Event (PPE).
Unit Execution Price: $0.001 USD.

post.summary: Synchronously execute domain-security-super-auditor and retrieve output dataset items
post.description: Starts the Actor, waits for execution to complete, and directly returns the output dataset records as a JSON array. Recommended for RapidAPI integrations.

requestBody.description: Actor configuration and runtime input parameters

domains.title: Target Domains
domains.description: List of domains, hostnames, or URLs to audit for security, SSL/TLS, and DNS posture.

include_dns_deliverability.title: Include DNS & Email Deliverability Audit
include_dns_deliverability.description: Audit MX records, mail provider fingerprinting, SPF syntax and RFC 7208 lookup limit, and DMARC enforcement.

include_rdap_age.title: Include RDAP Domain Age & Registrar Intelligence
include_rdap_age.description: Query official RDAP endpoints for registration date, domain age in days, registrar name, and burner domain risk.

timeout_seconds.title: Connection Timeout (Seconds)
timeout_seconds.description: Network timeout limit per check in seconds.

alert_threshold_days.title: SSL Expiry Alert Threshold (Days)
alert_threshold_days.description: Flag certificate as expiring soon if days until expiration is less than or equal to this threshold.

concurrency.title: Worker Concurrency
concurrency.description: Number of concurrent asynchronous domain audits running simultaneously.

max_domains.title: Maximum Domains Cap
max_domains.description: Maximum number of domains to process in a single run.

200.description: Actor executed successfully; returns output items array

401.description: Unauthorized; valid Apify API token required

post.description: Queues an asynchronous Actor execution run on Apify Cloud and returns run status metadata.
